description: Use this when a task on minipacs.net is done or abandoned, to tell the site's team how it went: what worked, what was missing or wrong. Returns received: true once stored.

detail.description: What worked and what was missing or wrong, up to 2000 characters.

outcome.description: How the task went: success, partial or failure.

page.description: The page URL or path the feedback is about.

task.description: What you were trying to do on the site, up to 500 characters.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the website
